kurals.tr: Ozhukkaaraak Kolka Oruvandhan Nenjaththu / Azhukkaaru Ilaadha Iyalpu
kurals.m: Let a man esteem that disposition which is free from envy in the same manner as propriety of conduct

kurals.tr: Vizhuppetrin Aqdhoppadhu Illaiyaar Maattum / Azhukkaatrin Anmai Perin
kurals.m: Amongst all attainable excellences there is none equal to that of being free from envy towords others

kurals.tr: Aranaakkam Ventaadhaan Enpaan Piranaakkam / Penaadhu Azhukkarup Paan
kurals.m: Of him who instead of rejoicing in the wealth of others, envies it, it will be said "he neither desires virtue not wealth."

kurals.tr: Azhukkaatrin Allavai Seyyaar Izhukkaatrin / Edham Patupaakku Arindhu
kurals.m: (The wise) knowing the misery that comes from transgression will not through envy commit unrighteous deeds

kurals.tr: Azhukkaaru Utaiyaarkku Adhusaalum Onnaar / Vazhukka�yum Keteen Padhu
kurals.m: To those who cherish envy that is enough Though free from enemies that (envy) will bring destruction

kurals.tr: Kotuppadhu Azhukkaruppaan Sutram Utuppadhooum / Unpadhooum Indrik Ketum
kurals.m: He who is envious at a gift (made to another) will with his relations utterly perish destitute of food and rainment

kurals.tr: Avviththu Azhukkaaru Utaiyaanaich Cheyyaval / Thavvaiyaik Kaatti Vitum
kurals.m: Lakshmi envying (the prosperity) of the envious man will depart and introduce him to her sister

kurals.tr: Azhukkaaru Enaoru Paavi Thiruchchetruth / Theeyuzhi Uyththu Vitum
kurals.m: Envy will destroy (a man's) wealth (in his world) and drive him into the pit of fire (in the world to come.)

kurals.tr: Avviya Nenjaththaan Aakkamum Sevviyaan / Ketum Ninaikkap Patum
kurals.m: The wealth of a man of envious mind and the poverty of the righteous will be pondered

kurals.tr: Azhukkatru Akandraarum Illai Aqdhuillaar / Perukkaththil Theerndhaarum Il
kurals.m: Never have the envious become great; never have those who are free from envy been without greatness
